messages:
katie: Kicking off perf validation for the new chi2b AZ GPUs. Goal: baseline p50/p95 for text-generation workloads, verify kernel/driver parity, NVLink/PCIe checks, and NIC MTU across racks. Follow the checklist below and post quick numbers here.

katie: Runbook (short):
- bootstrap nodes: reprovision image -> install drivers -> run node smoke
- kernel/driver check: `uname -r`, `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv`
- nvlink/pcie health: `nvidia-smi topo -m`
- perf: run microbench + end-to-end generation (small model + long context)
- networking: verify MTU, tcp window, RDMA if present
- handoff: mark nodes ready + add to Dedicated pool

sam: Starting node smoke on node-chi2b-01 now. pulling image rwinf/base:2026-02.

sam: smoke logs show CUDA init ok but a few warnings about uvm. p95 for simple echo job ~1.7s — baseline should be ~0.45s.

raj: can you paste `nvidia-smi` and `dmesg | grep -i nvidia`? maybe module mismatch.

sam: `nvidia-smi` -> DRIVER 535.68, CUDA 12.2

sam: `uname -r` -> 6.1.0-rc2-custom

sam: dmesg shows: "nvidia: version magic 6.0.0-... required by nvidia.ko" and several UVM allocation retries.

miko: that looks like kernel + module ABI mismatch, likely we built the image against 6.0 but kernel is 6.1. Quick options: use matching driver kernel module or boot expected kernel.

katie: ops-bot, cordon node-chi2b-01 while we remediate? we don't want it in the Dedicated pool with flaky drivers.

ops-bot: /k8s cordon node-chi2b-01 — success. Node cordoned by katie.

raj: For a fast verify I pulled the node kernel headers and recompiled the driver. re-run `modprobe -r nvidia_uvm && modprobe nvidia_uvm` then re-run bench.

sam: reloaded modules. `nvidia-smi` now shows DRIVER 550.25 (module compiled against current kernel). Run perf again.

sam: microbench (latency-only): p50 0.38s p95 0.51s — much better. E2E gen (1k tokens): p50 0.9s p95 1.1s (baseline target p95 <1.2s)

miko: good. we should still validate NVLink topology: `nvidia-smi topo -m` shows expected links between GPUs 0<->1, 2<->3. no NVLINK errors.

raj: also noticed two nodes had NIC MTU 1500 while others 9000. That can cause packet fragmentation and stall large KV cache transfers. Run `ip link show` and set `ip link set dev eth0 mtu 9000` on the ones with 1500.

sam: changed MTU on node-chi2b-04 and -07 to 9000. re-ran large-batch workload — throughput +8%, variance dropped.

katie: summary so far: driver/kernel mismatch fixed by rebuilding module -> improved p95 across bench. MTU mismatch fixed -> throughput up. NVLink topology good. Next: run 6-hour soak on 10 nodes and collect perf traces, then handoff to capacity-planning.

deploy-bot: perf-bench-run v2 completed on cluster chi2b (run id: 2026-03-18-1850). Artifacts at https://artifacts.redwood/chi2b/perf/v2

miko: note for runbook update: add explicit kernel-version pinning step and MTU verification before adding nodes to pool. I'll open a PR. :memo:

katie: thanks everyone. if the 6-hour soak looks stable we'll mark cluster chi2b ready and trigger Dedicated oncall for ramp.

sam: posting raw numbers to the artifact link now. will follow-up with perf flamegraphs if anything funky shows up. :mag:
